explanation: Classic inferior STEMI with ST elevation in the inferior leads (II, III, aVF) and reciprocal ST depression in I and aVL. The inferior wall is RCA-supplied in ~80% of patients. Note: ST elevation greater in III than II favors RCA over LCx. Always check V4R for RV involvement.
